first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A black-gray long gun that moves with the first-person viewpoint, with part of the gun extending into the frame from the bottom edge and a fork-shaped front sight at the front.

entities.name: damp, debris-strewn corridor floor
entities.identification: The dark floor in the lower part of the corridor, with reflective standing water, light-colored broken panels, and fragments distributed across its surface.

entities.name: peeling two-tone corridor wall
entities.identification: A wall surface that is light above and dark below, with peeling paint; near the start, the lower part of the nearby wall is brownish yellow, while the lower part of the wall farther inside the corridor is dark gray-green.

entities.name: light-colored narrow windowed door on the right wall
entities.identification: A dirty, worn, off-white rectangular door panel on the right wall, with a long, narrow vertical rectangular window set into its middle.

entities.name: group of wooden pallets on the right
entities.identification: Brown slatted wooden pallets beside the door on the right wall, including a diagonally leaning section and a section lying flat on the floor.

entities.name: open doorway at the far end of the corridor
entities.identification: A rectangular entrance deep in the corridor, partially occluded by a dark door panel on the left, with a brighter space behind it visible on the right.

entities.name: damaged suspended ceiling
entities.identification: Light-colored panels and support strips above the corridor, with missing panels, dark gaps, and panels folded downward.

entities.name: bent strip-shaped component
entities.identification: A long, slender gray-brown component extending into the frame from the upper-left edge above the window blinds, locally bent and then extending toward the lower left.

entities.name: hanging corridor cables
entities.identification: Thin black hanging cables on the upper part of the right wall, forming a long, narrow U-shaped loop nearby.

entities.name: window blinds on the left
entities.identification: A bright rectangular window on the left wall, with horizontal blinds and narrow vertical dividers inside and a darker surrounding frame.

entities.name: gray radiator below the window
entities.identification: A gray multi-section radiator below the window blinds on the left, composed of narrow vertical sections arranged side by side.

entities.name: scattered corridor debris
entities.identification: Large light-gray broken panels, long narrow strips, irregular fragments, and dust-like fine debris on the floor.

entities.name: standing water on the corridor floor
entities.identification: Dark standing water with irregular edges on the floor, with bright, intermittent reflections on the water surface.
